SPEC FILE:
- docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md defines the foundational ESLint plugin structure and requirements (plugin registration, ESLint v9 flat config compatibility, rule registry, config system, error handling, npm packaging, TypeScript, and test setup).

CORE PLUGIN IMPLEMENTATION (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TYPESCRIPT):
- src/index.ts:
 - JSDoc traceability:
 - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md
 - @req REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE - Provide foundational plugin export and registration
 - @req REQ-ERROR-HANDLING - Gracefully handles plugin loading errors and missing dependencies
 - Defines RULE_NAMES array of rule IDs: "require-story-annotation", "require-req-annotation", "require-branch-annotation", "valid-annotation-format", "valid-story-reference", "valid-req-reference".
 - Dynamically loads each rule into a Record using require(`./rules/${name}`) and supports default exports.
 - On load failure, logs an error and installs a placeholder rule module (see Error Handling evidence).
 - Defines configs with recommended and strict presets mapping traceability/* rules to ESLint severities.
 - Exports { rules, configs } and default { rules, configs }, matching standard ESLint plugin structure.
- src/rules directory contains TypeScript rule implementations for all listed rules (require-story-annotation.ts, require-req-annotation.ts, require-branch-annotation.ts, valid-annotation-format.ts, valid-story-reference.ts, valid-req-reference.ts).
- TypeScript & build setup:
 - tsconfig.json configures compilation to lib/ (CommonJS, declarations, strict settings).
 - package.json scripts: "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json", "type-check": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json".
- NPM package structure (REQ-NPM-PACKAGE):
 - package.json: "name": "eslint-plugin-traceability", "main": "lib/src/index.js", "types": "lib/src/index.d.ts", "peerDependencies": { "eslint": "^9.0.0" }, "engines": { "node": ">=14" }.
 - files: ["lib", "README.md", "LICENSE"].
 - lib/src/index.js exists (confirmed via check_file_exists).

ESLINT V9 FLAT CONFIG INTEGRATION (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT):
- eslint.config.js:
 - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md, @req REQ-FLAT-CONFIG.
 - Uses ESLint v9 flat-config style: module.exports = [ ... ].
 - Dynamically resolves plugin implementation:
 - Tries require("./src/index.js"), falls back to require("./lib/src/index.js").
 - If neither present in CI, throws a clear error; in local dev, logs a warning and uses an empty plugin object.
 - Wires plugin into flat config sections via plugins: { ...(plugin.rules ? { traceability: plugin } : {}) }.
 - Provides dedicated config for tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts and for TypeScript/JavaScript source files.

ERROR HANDLING (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, ACCEPTANCE CRITERION MARKED [x]):
- src/index.ts dynamic loading:
 - For each RULE_NAME, wraps require(`./rules/${name}`) in try/catch. On error:
 - console.error(`[eslint-plugin-traceability] Failed to load rule "${name}": ${error.message}`);
 - rules[name] set to placeholder RuleModule with meta.docs.description = `Failed to load rule '${name}'` and a Program visitor that calls context.report with message `eslint-plugin-traceability: Error loading rule "${name}": ${error.message}`.
- tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts:
 - Header: "Tests for: docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md", @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md, @req REQ-ERROR-HANDLING.
 - beforeEach mocks console.error and forces ../src/rules/require-branch-annotation to throw new Error("Test load error").
 - Test "[REQ-ERROR-HANDLING] should report error loading rule and provide placeholder rule":
 - Requires "../src/index", triggering dynamic loading.
 - Asserts console.error called with string containing 'Failed to load rule "require-branch-annotation": Test load error'.
 - Asserts plugin.rules["require-branch-annotation"] exists, its meta.docs.description mentions the load failure, and its create(...) visitor reports an error message containing 'Error loading rule "require-branch-annotation": Test load error'.
- tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts:
 - Header: @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md, @req REQ-ERROR-HANDLING.
 - Spawns ESLint CLI with this plugin and asserts non-zero exit and expected error text when running with a rule that should fail (validating CLI-level error behavior).

traceability.notes: Based on the codebase and tests, Story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented. The plugin core (src/index.ts) provides a standard ESLint plugin structure with rules and flat-config-style presets, implemented in TypeScript and built to lib/ for npm publishing. Dynamic rule loading with robust error handling is present and thoroughly tested (plugin-setup-error and CLI error tests). ESLint v9 flat-config integration is implemented in eslint.config.js and validated via CLI integration tests. The project includes a complete Jest-based test infrastructure, and user-facing documentation in README.md gives clear installation and configuration instructions, satisfying the user experience and documentation criteria. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are met with concrete implementation and passing tests.
